changes.title: Ken Martin hunkers down at the Democratic National Committee as a storm gathers around party leader
changes.summary: Desperate to save his job as chair of the Democratic National Committee, he is avoiding media appearances, monitoring his critics' social media posts and refusing — at least so far — to make any substantive changes at his troubled organization.
